Riley (People Ops): Thanks for coming to today's all-hands! Opening a short live follow-up for questions we didn't get to on offsite safety, privacy, insurance, and conduct. Keep questions short and we'll answer live. I'll update the Workstyle FAQ after. https://intranet.redwood/workstyle :memo:

Asha Menon: Quick privacy Q 1 when we're at an offsite in another country, are we allowed to sync customer data locally on our laptops for demos?

Sam (Security): Short answer: no private customer data should be copied to personal devices while traveling unless it's approved and encrypted. Use the secure demo environment or request an approved travel VM (people-ops + security will provision). If you need an exception, DM Security with the dataset details and we'll advise. :lock:

Diego Rivera: Travel insurance 1 does company insurance cover lost baggage and trip interruption for offsite travel? How do we file claims?

Riley (People Ops): Company travel insurance covers trip interruption, medical emergencies, and baggage up to policy limits when traveling on company business. If you need to file, email travel-claims@redwood.com within 7 days with receipts and incident report. For pre-approvals (e.g., EVAC), contact people-ops immediately.

Asha Menon: Conduct/harassment at offsites 1 what are the reporting channels if something happens after-hours at a venue?

Riley (People Ops): Report immediately to the onsite lead + people-ops. If you prefer anonymity, use the Ethics Hotline (link in the playbook) or DM People Ops; we will escalate to Legal and Security as needed. We have an offsite safety runbook and onsite code-of-conduct posters. If you need immediate help, call the emergency contact on the offsite itinerary. :telephone_receiver:

Sam (Security): Also a security note: avoid public Wi-Fi for admin/infra tasks. Use the company VPN and, for sensitive work, the approved travel VM. If you see suspicious USB drives or social engineering attempts at social events, notify Security.

Diego Rivera: Mental-health / burnout during long offsites 1 any support or quiet rooms? Can we book mental health breaks?

WellnessBot: Reminder: Redwood provides 10 paid mental health days per year (HR policy) and access to 24/7 counseling. For offsites, we reserve a quiet room and flexible scheduling on request. Submit a short note to people-ops to block quiet time or request a counselor drop-in. :seedling:

Asha Menon: If a manager schedules an optional late-night social event, is attendance considered work time? Any expense coverage for taxis late at night?

Riley (People Ops): Optional socials are not mandatory. If you feel unsafe returning late, request a company taxi and tag expense `offsite-safety-ride`. For mandatory events called out as part of the program, travel time and reasonable transport are covered; add a short note on the expense. Safety first.

Sam (Security): Reminder on devices: enable full-disk encryption and ensure laptop firewall is on. If you lose a device while traveling, report to Security immediately so we can remote-wipe if needed.

Diego Rivera: Social event expenses 1 if a small team organizes a pizza night and we all split the bill, who submits the expense?

Riley (People Ops): For informal team socials under $250, one person can submit and add attendee names in the notes; we'll allocate across cost centers if requested. For larger social budgets or vendor-hosted events, request People Ops coordination and pre-approval. Tag socials as `team-social` and include attendee list.

Asha Menon: Any data residency requirements for recordings at offsite presentations? Can we record a session that includes customer info?

Sam (Security): Do not record sessions that include customer PII or confidential content unless you have explicit permission and a data-handling plan. If recording, store on the company cloud with the appropriate retention tags and inform participants. For cross-border storage questions, ping Legal + Security before recording.

Riley (People Ops): Quick example copy for an expense note (feel free to paste):

```
Expense title: Offsite-SafetyTaxi
Amount: 45.00
Category: Ground - Taxi
Receipt: taxi_0527.pdf
Tag: offsite-safety-ride
Notes: Late-night return from optional social, company taxi requested for safety
```

Riley (People Ops): Thanks everyone 1 I'll add these clarifications to the Workstyle FAQ and the offsite runbook. If you need an emergency letter, travel VM, or confidential reporting help, DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com. :shield:
